guidance: Browser engine uses the signed-in ChatGPT profile; run dryRun:true before live use.
Manual-login browser mode uses Oracle's private Chrome profile at ~/.oracle/browser-profile, separate from your normal Chrome profile.

First-time setup: run oracle --engine browser --browser-manual-login --browser-keep-browser --browser-manual-login-profile-dir "~/.oracle/browser-profile" -p "HI", sign into ChatGPT in that window, then retry the consult.
If this profile is not signed in, non-setup MCP/browser runs fail fast instead of waiting for the full browser timeout.
